notes.title: New Civilization DLC Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343830/5141febcf5c25281c8e6101089214c020d9bc1fa.png[/img]


Today we released our new civilization DLC in 4x4 PROGRESS!
Enjoy the atmosphere and game style of the newly added civilizations, and progress from the Stone Age to the Modern Era once again.


[h2]Includes 4 new civilizations.[/h2]
[list][*]Netherland: A civilization that reclaims land and produces resources. Unique tiles include Windmills and the East India Company.[/list]
[list][*]Babylon: A civilization that snowballs with advanced science and technology in the Stone Age. Unique tiles include Hanging Gardens and Ishtar Gate.[/list]
[list][*]Indonesia: A civilization that uses the sea on a limited land area made up of archipelagos. Unique tiles include Bells and Candi Ventar.[/list]
[list][*]Italy: A civilization that lets you enjoy the prosperity of the Roman Empire through tight city design. Unique tiles include the Aqueduct, Colosseum and Forum Romano.[/list]

notes.title: New Civilization DLC Update!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554880/4X4_PROGRESS__Civilization_Pack_II/][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GoN75sBaEAAqa7h?format=jpg&name=medium[/img][/url]

Today we released our new civilization DLC in 4x4 PROGRESS!
Enjoy the atmosphere and game style of the newly added civilizations, and progress from the Stone Age to the Modern Era once again.

[h2]Includes 4 new civilizations.[/h2]
[list][*]Greece: A civilization that summons gods and gains powerful buffs by collecting Faith, a unique resource of Greece. Unique tiles include the Acropolis and Amphitheater.[/list]
[list][*]Shona: A civilization that expands the use of stone resources, builds buildings with stone, and fights against raids. Unique tiles include Great Zimbabwe and Shona Pieces.[/list]
[list][*]France: A beautiful civilization with abundant resources. However, human rights for human resources must be guaranteed! Unique tiles include the Chateau and the Eiffel Tower.[/list]
[list][*]Hawaii: A challenging civilization that develops a small but beautiful island dominated by the ocean. Unique tiles include canoes and beach resorts.[/list]
